details:
This is so frustrating, because I won't know until the end if it'll fail or not. I've been trying to figure this out for weeks, until recently. Apparently these prefabs I bought from the Unity Asset Store was the cause,  so I swap them and use the models themselves in the scene and that work. Then the problem arises again after doing some more work. I have no idea why it's doing this. I thought maybe it was because of the world is to big, but it's just under 200MB.
